---
description: "Watch a whole day of Island Transit's buses on the map again, each colored by how far it ran from the timetable."
title: "Replay a day"
subtitle: "Every bus we saw, minute by minute, on one of the last 14 days with service"
include-in-header:
  - _head.html
  - _leaflet.html
---

Pick a day and move the slider, or press Play, to watch the buses go. Each
bus takes the color and shape of its last timed stop: on time (1 minute
early to 5 minutes late), early, or late. A bus that has not passed a
timed stop on its trip yet, or is not running a trip, is drawn as a ring.
Point at a bus, or tap it, to see its route and the routes it ran that
day: buses often change routes during the day. Buses at the same place, such
as several waiting at a transfer center, are drawn side by side around it.
Times are in Pacific time.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {json, routeMap, routeTitle, longDate, lateness, emptyNote, guard, h, BANDS, NO_BAND, bandIconHTML, bandIcon, plural} from "./lib.js"
import {drawRouteMap} from "./map.js"
import {makeCharts} from "./charts.js"
import {Plot} from "./vendor/plot-0.6.11/plot.js"
ch = makeCharts({Plot})
L = require(new URL("vendor/leaflet-1.9.4/leaflet.js", document.baseURI).href)
recent = json("data/ontime/recent.json")
mapData = routeMap(recent?.timepoints)
replayIndex = json("data/views/replay/index.json")
replayDays = (replayIndex?.days ?? []).filter(d => typeof d === "string")
routeById = Object.fromEntries((mapData?.routes ?? []).map(r => [r.route_id, r]))
routeName = id => id == null ? "no trip" : routeById[id] ? routeTitle(routeById[id]) : `route ${id}`
// What a bus's last timed stop said, drawn like the on-time bands.
STATES = [
  {key: "good", short: "on time", shape: "circle", label: "On time at its last timed stop"},
  {key: "warning", short: "early", shape: "triangle", label: "Early at its last timed stop"},
  {key: "critical", short: "late", shape: "square", label: "Late at its last timed stop"},
  {key: "none", short: "not timed", shape: "ring", label: "Not timed yet on this trip, or not on a trip"},
]
clockOf = s => {
  const hh = Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24, mm = Math.floor(s / 60) % 60;
  return `${(hh + 11) % 12 + 1}:${String(mm).padStart(2, "0")} ${hh < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof day = {
  if (replayDays.length === 0) return Object.assign(emptyNote("unavailable", "The list of days"), {value: null});
  const wanted = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
  const start = replayDays.includes(wanted) ? wanted : replayDays.at(-1);
  const select = h("select", {id: "day-pick"}, ...[...replayDays].reverse().map(d =>
    h("option", {value: d, selected: d === start ? "" : null}, longDate(d))));
  const box = h("div", {class: "picker route-picker"}, h("label", {for: "day-pick"}, "Day"), select);
  box.value = start;
  select.addEventListener("change", () => {
    box.value = select.value;
    history.replaceState(history.state, "", `#${select.value}`);
    box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  });
  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
raw = day ? json(`data/views/replay/${day}.json`) : null
// A trip's timed stops; a malformed entry is left out rather than trusted.
tripList = (raw?.trips ?? []).map(x => ({trip_id: x?.trip_id ?? null, route_id: x?.route_id ?? null,
  timed: (Array.isArray(x?.timed) ? x.timed : []).filter(e => Array.isArray(e) && e.every(Number.isFinite))}))
// Undo the delta coding once per day: absolute times and positions.
buses = {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw?.buses) || !Number.isFinite(raw.scale)) return [];
  const sum = a => { let x = 0; return a.map(d => (x += d)); };
  const whole = a => Array.isArray(a) && a.length > 0 && a.every(Number.isFinite);
  return raw.buses.filter(b => b && whole(b.t) && whole(b.lat) && whole(b.lon) && b.lat.length === b.t.length
    && b.lon.length === b.t.length && Array.isArray(b.trips) && b.trips.every(r => Array.isArray(r) && r.every(Number.isInteger)))
  .map(b => {
    const t = sum(b.t), lat = sum(b.lat).map(v => v / raw.scale), lon = sum(b.lon).map(v => v / raw.scale);
    const tripAt = new Int32Array(t.length).fill(-1);
    b.trips.forEach(([from, k], j) => tripAt.fill(k, from, b.trips[j + 1]?.[0] ?? t.length));
    // The routes this bus ran, in order, with the time it started each.
    const runs = [];
    for (const [from, k] of b.trips) {
      const route = tripList[k]?.route_id ?? null;
      if (route != null && runs.at(-1)?.route !== route) runs.push({route, from: t[from]});
    }
    return {bus: b.bus, t, lat, lon, tripAt, runs};
  });
}
span = buses.length ? [Math.min(...buses.map(b => b.t[0])), Math.max(...buses.map(b => b.t.at(-1)))] : [0, 0]
```

::: {.replay-controls .slot-controls}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof clock = {
  // Whole minutes at both ends, so every step of the slider is a clock time
  // ending in :00, :20 or :40. It starts at 8 AM, when most buses are out.
  const lo = Math.floor(span[0] / 60) * 60, hi = Math.ceil(span[1] / 60) * 60;
  const first = lo <= 28800 && 28800 <= hi ? 28800 : lo;
  const input = h("input", {type: "range", id: "replay-clock", min: lo, max: hi, step: 20, value: first, "aria-valuetext": clockOf(first)});
  const shown = h("output", {for: "replay-clock", class: "replay-time"}, clockOf(first));
  const play = h("button", {type: "button", class: "replay-play", "aria-pressed": "false"}, "Play");
  const speed = h("select", {id: "replay-speed", "aria-label": "Speed"},
    h("option", {value: "60"}, "1 minute a second"),
    h("option", {value: "300", selected: ""}, "5 minutes a second"),
    h("option", {value: "900"}, "15 minutes a second"));
  const box = h("div", {class: "replay-bar"}, h("label", {for: "replay-clock"}, "Time"), input, shown, play, speed);
  box.value = first;
  const set = s => {
    box.value = Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, s));
    input.value = box.value;
    shown.textContent = clockOf(box.value);
    input.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", clockOf(box.value));
    box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  input.addEventListener("input", () => set(+input.value));
  let timer = null;
  const stop = () => { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; play.textContent = "Play"; play.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); };
  play.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (timer) return stop();
    if (box.value >= hi) set(lo);
    play.textContent = "Pause";
    play.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      set(box.value + +speed.value / 10);
      if (box.value >= hi) stop();
    }, 100);
  });
  if (lo === hi) { input.disabled = true; play.disabled = true; }
  invalidation.then(stop);
  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
mapView = {
  if (!mapData?.routes) return null;
  const view = drawRouteMap(L, mapData, null, {plain: true,
    label: "Map of Island Transit's buses at the time picked, on the route lines. The same buses are listed under the map."});
  view.buses = L.layerGroup().addTo(view.map);
  invalidation.then(() => view.destroy());
  return view;
}
// Where each bus was, what it was running and how its last timed stop went,
// at the time on the slider. A bus not heard from in 5 minutes is not shown.
now = {
  const out = [];
  for (const b of buses) {
    let i = -1, lo = 0, hi = b.t.length - 1;
    while (lo <= hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (b.t[mid] <= clock) { i = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1; }
    if (i < 0 || clock - b.t[i] > 300) continue;
    let lat = b.lat[i], lon = b.lon[i];
    const j = i + 1;
    if (j < b.t.length && b.t[j] - b.t[i] <= 120 && b.tripAt[j] === b.tripAt[i]) {
      const f = (clock - b.t[i]) / (b.t[j] - b.t[i]);
      lat += f * (b.lat[j] - lat);
      lon += f * (b.lon[j] - lon);
    }
    const k = b.tripAt[i];
    const trip = tripList[k] ?? null;
    const last = trip?.timed.filter(x => x[0] <= clock).at(-1) ?? null;
    const state = STATES[last ? last[2] : 3];
    out.push({bus: b.bus, lat, lon, trip, state, late: last ? last[1] * 6 : null, runs: b.runs});
  }
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Move the bus markers. Each bus keeps one marker for the whole day; only
// its place, its icon and its tip change.
markers = {
  const keep = new Map();
  const GAP = 30;  // pixels between bus centers: a 28-pixel marker and a little room
  // Buses at the same place, such as several waiting at a transfer center,
  // are drawn side by side in a small ring around it, so each can be pointed
  // at and tapped. The ring depends on the zoom, so it is redrawn with it.
  keep.fan = () => {
    const map = mapView?.map;
    if (!map || !map._loaded) return;
    const shown = [...keep.values()].filter(m => mapView.buses.hasLayer(m) && m.home);
    const home = new Map(shown.map(m => [m, map.latLngToLayerPoint(m.home)]));
    const at = new Map();
    const done = new Set();
    for (const m of shown) {
      if (done.has(m)) continue;
      const group = shown.filter(o => !done.has(o) && home.get(o).distanceTo(home.get(m)) < GAP);
      group.forEach(o => done.add(o));
      const c = group.reduce((s, o) => s.add(home.get(o)), L.point(0, 0)).divideBy(group.length);
      // Neighbors on the ring are GAP apart in both directions, so square
      // markers do not overlap at their corners.
      const r = group.length === 1 ? 0 : (GAP * Math.SQRT2 / 2) / Math.sin(Math.PI / group.length);
      group.forEach((o, k) => {
        const a = 2 * Math.PI * k / group.length - Math.PI / 2;
        at.set(o, c.add(L.point(r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a))));
      });
    }
    // Then push apart any two whose squares still overlap (two rings that
    // happen to be close).
    for (let pass = 0; pass < 30; pass++) {
      let moved = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < shown.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < shown.length; j++) {
        const a = at.get(shown[i]), b = at.get(shown[j]);
        const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
        if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) >= GAP) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, ux = dx ? dx / d : 1, uy = dy / d;
        const push = (GAP - Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy))) / 2 + 0.5;
        at.set(shown[i], L.point(a.x - ux * push, a.y - uy * push));
        at.set(shown[j], L.point(b.x + ux * push, b.y + uy * push));
        moved = true;
      }
      if (!moved) break;
    }
    for (const m of shown) m.setLatLng(map.layerPointToLatLng(at.get(m)));
  };
  mapView?.map.on("load zoomend", keep.fan);
  invalidation.then(() => { mapView?.map.off("load zoomend", keep.fan); mapView?.buses.clearLayers(); });
  return keep;
}
{
  if (!mapView) return;
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const b of now) {
    seen.add(b.bus);
    const runs = b.runs.map(r => `${routeName(r.route)} from ${clockOf(r.from)}`).join(", ");
    const tip = `<strong>Bus ${b.bus}</strong><br>${b.trip ? `${routeName(b.trip.route_id)}, trip ${b.trip.trip_id}` : "Not running a trip"}<br>${
      b.late != null ? `${lateness(b.late)} at its last timed stop` : "Not timed yet on this trip"}${runs ? `<br>Its day: ${runs}` : ""}`;
    let m = markers.get(b.bus);
    if (!m) {
      m = L.marker([b.lat, b.lon], {keyboard: true, icon: L.divIcon({className: "bus-marker", html: "", iconSize: [28, 28]})})
        .bindTooltip("", {className: "map-tip", direction: "top", offset: [0, -10]});
      m.state = null;
      // Leaflet makes the marker's element only once the map shows it.
      m.on("add", () => m.getElement()?.setAttribute("aria-label", m.label));
      markers.set(b.bus, m);
    }
    m.home = L.latLng(b.lat, b.lon);
    m.setLatLng(m.home);
    if (m.state !== b.state.key) {
      m.setIcon(L.divIcon({className: "bus-marker", html: bandIconHTML(b.state, 16), iconSize: [28, 28]}));
      m.state = b.state.key;
    }
    m.setTooltipContent(tip);
    m.label = `Bus ${b.bus}: ${b.trip ? routeName(b.trip.route_id) : "not running a trip"}, ${b.state.label.toLowerCase()}`;
    if (!mapView.buses.hasLayer(m)) mapView.buses.addLayer(m);
    m.getElement()?.setAttribute("aria-label", m.label);
  }
  for (const [bus, m] of markers) if (!seen.has(bus)) mapView.buses.removeLayer(m);
  markers.fan();
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => {
  if (!raw) return emptyNote("unavailable", "This day's buses");
  const count = k => now.filter(b => b.state.key === k).length;
  const say = now.length === 0 ? `No bus was out at ${clockOf(clock)} on ${longDate(day)}.`
    : `At ${clockOf(clock)} on ${longDate(day)}, we saw ${plural(now.length, "bus", "buses")}: ${count("good")} on time, ${count("warning")} early, ${count("critical")} late and ${count("none")} not timed yet or not on a trip.`;
  return html`<p class="replay-summary">${say}</p>${now.length === 0 ? "" : ch.table(now.map(b => ({...b, route: b.trip ? routeName(b.trip.route_id) : "No trip"})), {
    caption: `Buses at ${clockOf(clock)}`,
    columns: [
      {key: "bus", label: "Bus"},
      {key: "route", label: "Route"},
      {key: "late", label: "Last timed stop", format: (v, r) => v == null ? "Not timed yet" : `${lateness(v)} (${r.state.short})`},
      {key: "runs", label: "Routes that day", format: v => v.map(r => routeName(r.route)).join(", ") || "–"},
    ],
  })}`;
}, "The list of buses")
```

The buses' places come from the live feed every 20 seconds, with GPS glitches
taken out as they are for the on-time figures. Between two reports less than
2 minutes apart, a bus is drawn along the straight line between them, so it
can cut a corner. The timetable times come from Island Transit's printed
timetables, as on the rest of this site.
